statements: Raney says the suspected operation discussed using WebEx or Teams take-control features to avoid detections associated with standalone remote tools. During interviews, the remote operator could see and hear the same call and place answers in Notepad for the front person to read.
Disable or narrowly authorize give-control/take-control features for candidate interviews and onboarding calls.
